verified.exploit_entry_point: The fabio binary's HTTP listener: a raw HTTP/1.1 request with a hop-by-hop declaration is sent over loopback to the running proxy and the backend records the headers it received.
routes: an ordinary forwarded request whose hop-by-hop declaration names a header the proxy set
verified.project_tests_run: go test ./proxy -count=1 -run 'TestAddHeaders|TestAddResponseHeaders|TestLocalPort|TestUint16Base16|TestProxyProducesCorrectXForwardedSomethingHeader|TestProxyRequestIDHeader' at image build on the pinned tree

traps.shape: the header builder sets the forwarding headers, then the stock reverse proxy removes any header the client named in its hop-by-hop declaration, so the backend never sees the proxy's value
traps.reason_to_dismiss: the reported request looks like a client that asked for a header to be dropped; the damage is done inside the reverse proxy, not in the code the report names
traps.realistic_because: the advisory's own route at the pinned commit; the sanitiser exists in the published fix

patch_checks.why: blind fix produced by run_blindfix after the first gate
